## Complete Inspection

An inspection is a Work Order with `kind = inspection`. This command completes one and attaches the findings the inspector raised (`newFindings`, catalog Inspection Finding fields) to the order.

It shares the checklist gate with **Complete Work Order** through the same `checklistStats`, but takes no override: an inspection with unresolved required checklist items is not done, and the command refuses it. It also refuses a Work Order whose kind is not `inspection`, so a corrective job cannot be closed through this path by mistake.

### Non-goals

It does not raise follow-up Work Orders for the findings; a caller that wants one per finding calls **Raise Work Order**.
